summary: Implemented all 8 plan phases for detecting a stranded dispatch from its own stale heartbeat. dispatch-strand-probe.sh (new, read-only) implements the measured conjunction and feeds three consumers: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's new stranded_suspected field, skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's existing one-re-prompt relay (ORed with stall_suspected, disambiguated by a signal field), and reconcile-task-status.sh's demotion gate. lint-agent-contracts.sh gained Check K to mechanically reject the detach-then-await-a-notification antipattern. Full internal run-all.sh (147 suites) run twice; found and fixed two self-introduced regressions (a test section-scoping boundary, and a SKILL.md eager-load ceiling overrun) before redeploying.
